title: Antibiotic Treatment of Multiple Erythema Migrans
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the efficacy and safety of 15-day ceftriaxone versus 15-day doxycycline treatment in patients with multiple erythema migrans.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* multiple erythema migrans in patients \> 15 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* a history of Lyme borreliosis in the past
* pregnancy or lactation
* immunocompromised status
* serious adverse event to doxycycline or beta lactam antibiotic
* taking antibiotic with antiborrelial activity within 10 days
